biochemProducts.tableNote: HSN codes are chosen per product; the CA confirms each GST rate before the first bill. The checks here are a guide — the bill itself is checked again on the server.

before.title: Before these go on a bill
before.t1: Net quantity on the label and the bill
before.b1: The net quantity printed on the pack and the one on the bill must be the same, in the same unit. Litres and kilograms are never swapped.
before.t2: A product code for every fragrance and colour
before.b2: Each fragrance, colour and pack size needs its own code so stock and sales add up.
before.b3: Soap bars, hand wash and body wash are cosmetics. The manufacturing licence number goes on each of these products and on their labels.
before.b4: Maker's name and address, net quantity, MRP including all taxes, month of manufacture, expiry and the customer care line, on every pack.

bill.title: What the bill does with these
bill.b1: The GST rate comes from the HSN table for the bill date. A bill can't change the rate.
bill.b2: A price that includes tax is stopped at the printed MRP.
bill.b3: Taxable goods always go on a tax invoice. A bill without GST needs a lawful reason and only Admin can make one.
